defects.summary: best_network joined terminals by pairwise cheapest paths (a heuristic) and so missed the minimum-cost network; replaced by an exact node-weighted Steiner tree (Dreyfus-Wagner over cold-room subsets, rooted at the depot) with the contract's link-id vector tie rule folded into the link weights.

site_lines added the far end's activation charge once per booked link and gave no line to activated sites with no booked link; every activated site now pays its charge exactly once and each link cost is booked to its end with the larger corridor position.
configparser lower-cased activation.ini keys, so <project>/<site> overrides never matched; keys now keep their exact spelling and case (optionxform = str).
closed links from access_rules.toml [closed] were never removed; they are now dropped before the endpoint, reachability and network rules, and only counted in links.
layout slots were compared as strings; they are now compared as numbers.
a missing book file raised a raw error instead of MissingBookFile; all five files are now checked in contract order before anything is read, giving E_MISSING_FILE <name> and no documents.
the class charge was looked up even when an override existed; the override now replaces it without touching the class table.
share_bp rounded to nearest; it now rounds down (total * 10000 // quote).
task.VERSION was missing; set to the package manifest version 2.18.5.
version 0.0.0, requires-python >=3.13, a requests dependency and package-dir lib; now version 2.18.5, >=3.12, no dependencies, package-dir src.
